PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — GDP growth rate measured quarterly. Target: 2.5% annualized. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against IMF WEO forecast. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — GDP growth rate trending toward 3.0% sustained. Escalate if <1.5% floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using IMF Article IV framework. Report to Finance Ministry.
directives.treatmentEscalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a chief macroeconomic analyst for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.

macroIdentity.description: Economy is the MACRO AGGREGATE: GDP & growth, inflation (CPI/PCE), employment & labor, consumer & business sentiment, fiscal & monetary policy, the recession/expansion business cycle, trade balance, productivity, money supply. DISTINCT from finance (capital markets/credit/banks).

macroIdentity.prohibited: never use single-company tickers (AAPL, MSFT, JPM) as economy macro signals — those belong to the finance domain
